issues: The site passed its EHO inspection, with the regional head of kitchen attending in person and confirming the shop, food quality and Char Siu met the required standard.
Food cost ran above the weekly plan, the only site in the Scotland cluster to do so.
A three star Google review said the Char Siu was hard and the food too salty, and that the customer expected a more high end experience.
A staff transfer out to another site was confirmed and a further back of house team member may also transfer.
A front of house team member is leaving their second job in the next two to three weeks and will move to full time here.

The site is still unable to respond to Google reviews after account ownership was changed, and a year of review responses was deleted; access to manage the business account has been requested but not yet granted.
The Deliveroo report for the week is incomplete because Sunday's figures had not pulled through at the time of reporting.
Three Deliveroo refunds were recorded, one disputed with photo evidence, one disputed without, and one that could not be disputed.
Spend per head has dropped with the return of the lunch menu and heavy app voucher redemption.
Deliveroo prep time was affected by connectivity problems and the site wants it brought down.
App vouchers stay active on a customer's account until their expiry date rather than when they are redeemed in branch.
Pest control, fire safety, electrical, gas and ventilation compliance were all completed and signed off, and no maintenance jobs were logged.
XOXO, the Matcha specials and the Maki App are the live promotions.

Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): Following a Char Siu quality problem traced to the supplier, all sites must stay vigilant when opening new Char Siu deliveries, carry out random quality checks and test product quality before serving.

Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): Frozen ramen, ramen bowls and inner containers are to be ordered exclusively from JFC, while takeaway packaging remains with Lynas because of JFC packaging quality inconsistencies.
Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): The weekly BOH KPI meeting reverts to its regular Tuesday 10:30 slot, with the next one on 22/09/2026.
actions: Chase Google for the access needed to manage the business account and respond to reviews - Owner: Ross Ward (15/09/2026)
Finalise the following week's budget rota and draft the week after by end of day Tuesday - Owner: Rory Ferguson (15/09/2026)
